articleTitle: A zero trust method based on BLP and BIBA model
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Zero trust is a novel type of access control security architecture that adopts the fundamental principle of “never trust, always verify”. The Bell-LaPadula and BIBA Model follow the access control principles of “no read up, no write down” and “no write up, no read down” to meet the confidentiality and integrity goals respectively. This paper aims to further expand the concepts of subject, object and security label in the Bell-LaPadula and BIBA Model, propose a novel zero trust method. This method performs comprehensive trust scores on system components such as users, terminals, channels, files and applications, and sets different weights for confidentiality and integrity requirements, thereby achieving better confidentiality and integrity protection for objects.

articleTitle: Research on Engineering Vehicle Target Detection in Aerial Photography Environment based on YOLOX
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The aerial target detection of engineering vehicles such as excavators is the key technology for UAV inspection of optical cable lines and petroleum pipelines. It is proposed to apply the deep learning YOLOX (You Only Look Once version X) target detection algorithm to the target detection of engineering vehicles in aerial images. Based on the Pytorch deep learning framework, through the production of engineering vehicle aerial photography data sets, simulation has realized the target detection of engineering vehicles, and its target recognition AP@0.5:0.95 value reaches 59.38%. Based on the same data set and training conditions, its detection accuracy and speed surpass classic algorithms such as YOLOv4 and YOLOv5. The simulation results can provide a certain reference for the research of aerial inspection and maintenance of underground pipeline facilities.

articleTitle: Research on USV trajectory tracking method based on LOS algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to study the trajectory tracking control of unmanned surface vehicle (USV) in real water environment and improve the tracking accuracy under the influence of wind, waves and currents, a USV trajectory tracking control method based on line-of-sight (LOS) guidance algorithm is proposed. First, according to the structural characteristics of the USV, a nonlinear mathematical model is established. Then, the LOS guidance algorithm is used to transform the position tracking problem of the USV into a heading control problem, and the heading angle of the USV is made to converge to the desired heading angle by designing a nonlinear heading controller. Finally, multiple desired heading points are set in the real water environment and the tracking experiments are conducted, and good results are obtained, further verifying the engineering.

articleTitle: A Network Security Situation Prediction Method Based On SA-SSA
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Under the influence of big data and artificial intelligence, Network security situation prediction has become a hot research field in recent years. Situation prediction is the premise of cyber security warning. The uncertainty and nonlinearity of situation data bring great challenges to the accuracy of situation prediction models. In order to improve the accuracy and performance of situation prediction model, Combined with Sparrow Search Algorithm and Simplicial Algorithm, this paper proposed a network security situation prediction method based on SA-SSA and utilized SA-SSA to optimize structural hyperparameters of neural network situation prediction model. The method based on SA-SSA has better performance than conventional situation prediction model, it improved the accuracy of neural network model and minimize the training loss. The proposed method was verified in Python. The results show that the method can accomplish the task of situation prediction with better capability.

articleTitle: Design of Chinese Smart Kitchen Based on Users' Behavior
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The concept of smart kitchens has become a hot topic for Chinese families as IoT technology in smart homes has matured. Current smart kitchen includes a variety of smart products which are controlled via mobile terminals. However, the accumulation of smart items that focus on solving a single pain point reduces the available space in the kitchen, and decreases the efficiency of kitchen cooking. As a result, encouraging the systematization and integration of single-product smart kitchens is a critical design issue to be solved immediately. Based on behavioral research, this paper employs quantitative and qualitative methods to investigate the common behavioral characteristics and pain points of smart kitchen target user groups. According to the study of user behavior, requirements and smart kitchen technology, a systematic design goals of Chinese smart kitchens with emotional communication and all-in-one interaction are proposed, which solves the problems of trivial interaction and fragmented usage scenes in existing smart kitchens, providing constructive meaning for the human-centered design direction of Chinese smart kitchens.

articleTitle: A Two-stage Deep Neural Network for Macro- and Micro-Expression Spotting from Long-term Videos
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Facial macro- and micro-expression spotting is an important task in the micro-expression analysis. This paper presents a Two-Stage Macro- and Micro-expression Spotting Network (TSMSNet) to locate the temporal positions of macro-and micro-expression in long-term videos. It is composed of two sub-networks. The first sub-network is a Triplet-Stream Attention Network (TSANet), which uses three spatial feature extraction branches and attention mechanism to extract the spatial-temporal features. The TSANet is utilized to spot the macro- and micro-expression apex frames. According to the predicted apex frames, the initial expression intervals are recommended. The second network is a Spatial-Temporal Classification Network (STCNet), which utilizes the initial expression intervals to predict the multi-scale expression in-terval proposals. Comparative results show that the proposed expression spotting method has achieved the state-of-the-art performance in two benchmark databases CAS(ME)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and SAMM Long Videos.

articleTitle: Better than humans: a method for inferring consumer shopping intentions by reading facial expressions
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: How to make robots more human-like has been a hot topic of interest for researchers in the field of robot interaction. Empowering robots in retail services with empathy to read minds is still a major challenge. To address this problem, we proposed a deep learning-based method for programs to infer consumers' shopping interest levels, which we confirmed effectiveness has met or exceeded that of human judgement. The experimental results demonstrated that the proposed method achieved an accuracy of 65% in predicting consumer shopping interest levels, compared to the accuracy of 46% in predicting consumer shopping interest levels for manual assessment (n = 40), respectively. We anticipate that the results of this study will have considerable implications for research on human-robot interaction in service robots.

articleTitle: MinorNet: A Lightweight neural network for battlefield scene classification
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Computer vision has a wide range of applications, and the current demand for intelligent battlefields is increasing. However, most research on CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) models did not consider both accuracy and lightweight. To achieve an efficient neural network model for battlefield scene classification, we propose a lightweight and efficient neural network named the MinorNet. The design of MinorN et refers to the advantages and avoids the shortcomings of the previous models. Min bottleneck is an essential part of Minor Net. The Min bottleneck contains Depthwise Separable Convolution, channel shuffle, linear transformation, and residual part. They can further improve model capabilities and efficiency without increasing inference computation. This paper establishes a novel dataset named battlefield scene dataset of 7 different kinds of a real battlefield scenes. As a result, our MinorNet achieves 88.3% with only 2.4M parameters in the battlefield scene dataset, being about 0.5x smaller yet still more accurate 3.7% than the previously most commonly used lightweight place classification model.

articleTitle: Attention-based Joint Feature Extraction Model For Static Music Emotion Classification
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Music Emotion Recognition (MER) has attracted much attention in the last decades. Many novel methods and new audio features have been designed to improve the performance of MER algorithms. However, it is difficult to apply the previous methods in cross-modal interaction tasks and emotion-based music generation tasks. To overcome this issue, we conduct experiments on the 4Q audio emotion dataset for better application of MER. Furthermore, we propose a novel Attention-based Joint Feature Extraction Model (AJFEM) for high performance predictions in static MER. In the feature extraction module, we utilize the filter bank and log mel spectrograms to extract features. Specially, attention mechanism has been applied to extract emotion-related features. Then the automatically extracted features are input into GRU-SVM to get the classification results. The experimental results show that our model is superior to most of the compared methods, and has the potential to be applied to emotional interaction tasks.

articleTitle: Logistic Regression Based on t-Distribution Butterfly Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the field of machine learning (ML) and big data analysis, sample data often needs to be classified. Traditional logistic regression can predict the sample set, and it is also the main method to solve the problem of data classification. Compared with the traditional multiple linear regression, logistic regression uses Sigmoid function to replace the original linear discriminant function, and classifies the data with 0 and 1, which greatly reduces the influence of outliers on the discriminant function. In logistic regression, gradient descent (GD) method is often used to solve the parameters of loss function, however, in such optimal parameter solving process GD has the limitation that the objective function can only be a convex one, and the parameter solved is easy to fall into the trap of local extremum, which cannot ensure the global convergence. In this paper, t-distribution butterfly optimization algorithm (TBOA) is proposed to solve the problem of solving the optimal parameters in the loss function of logistic regression. Compared with the traditional butterfly optimization algorithm (BOA), TBOA uses limit threshold, simplex method and sine cosine algorithm to avoid falling into local extremum in the iterative process; and via numerical experiment, it has been verified that TBOA has better convergence and can better obtain the global optimal solution.

articleTitle: Handover Scheme and Performance Analysis of Improved Chess Board Protocol for High-Speed Maglev Train-Ground Millimeter Wave Communication
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: High-speed maglev is a type of railway system, its operation and control system (OCS) also relies on the train-ground wireless communication system, which is based on the 38GHz band millimeter wave. As high-speed maglev train can reach up to a higher speed than regular high-speed train, its residence time duration in the coverage area of each ground radio base station (RBS) can be very short, thus, reliable and effective handover scheme between ground RBSs for fast-moving train is needed. In current railway system, there are few train-ground communication systems using millimeter wave band, and there were few studies on millimeter wave based communication protocols. Based on the analysis of the design of high-speed maglev train-ground wireless communication system, in this paper, an improved chess board protocol and a data transmission handover scheme just based on the improved protocol have been proposed to adapt to both ordinary and train passing events, and the effectiveness of the proposed protocol as well as the handover scheme has been verified via simulation.

articleTitle: 555- Timer Chaos: Signal Discovery and Complexity Measure
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The most understanding chaotic circuit had been built in 555-timer with small loads and feedback components. These new chaotic signals were diagnosed by maximum Lyapunov exponent, spectral entropy complexity (SEC) and construction creep (CC) rate. The corresponding output phase plots were shown under 19-kind connection modes.

articleTitle: Product Design of Household Goods Management Based on RFID Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Find the defects and user pain points of existing household goods management products, improve the design of household goods management products, and enhance user experience. By analyzing the current status of the use of household goods management products and user needs, find out the shortcomings and user pain points in the use of existing products, and improve the integrated design of such products based on the diversified needs of users in the family life. Taking the pain points in the user's existing household goods management process as the problem point, an integrated design scheme of new family goods management products is proposed, which aims to improve the efficiency and experience of users in the daily management of household goods. By analyzing the general psychological characteristics and behaviors of users in household goods management, combined with the functional requirements of item search, storage, and expiration reminders, a family item management product based on RFID technology is designed.

articleTitle: Research on crew-level maintenance strategy for ship equipment based on risk-based decision
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of “excessive maintenance” in the current maintenance strategy for ship equipment and crew level, which leads to insufficient effective use period of equipment, waste of maintenance resources, and difficulty in identifying potential equipment failures, based on the risk decision theory, the ship equipment maintenance strategy model is established, and the analytic hierarchy process and the Delphi method are applied to obtain the dangerous impact value of each fault. On this basis, a reasonable maintenance support strategy is formulated according to the evaluation result to solve the existing maintenance strategy. The existing problems provide theoretical support. Based on the research results of this paper, the risk evaluation model of a shaft system intermediate bearing is established, and the risk maintenance strategy of this bearing is formulated. In order to improve the scientific nature of the maintenance strategy of this bearing, the validity of the research results of this paper is verified at the same time.

articleTitle: Mechanomyography signals processing method using multivariate variational mode decomposition
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the development of human-computer interaction technology, the wearable power-assisted robots gradually change from passively accepting users' instructions to actively recognizing users' intentions. More and more wearable power-assisted robots use human Mechanomyography (MMG) signals to recognize users' motion intentions. There is still a bottleneck problem in how to remove motion artifacts in the MMG signals. In this study, we propose the MMG signals processing method using Multivariate Variational Mode Decomposition (MVMD). The multi-channel MMG signals of the same muscles group are decomposed into several the Bandwidth-limited Intrinsic Mode Function (BIMF) components. Combined with the frequency and energy distribution of the MMG signal, the BIMF components are selected. The selected BIMF components are summed to obtain the MMG signals filtering noises such as motion artifacts. Compared with the Multivariate Empirical Mode Decomposition (MEMD), the Instantaneous Frequency (IF) of each channel BIMF components decomposed by MVMD is more stable, and the degree of mutual aliasing of the components is significantly reduced. The MMG signals energy is maximized while the noises such as motion artifact are filtered. The recognizability of the MMG signals is improved.

articleTitle: Research on fast construction of question answering system based on target graph
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of chaotic structure and lack of visual query methods in small sample domain data, this paper proposes a fast construction framework of question answering (QA) system based on target graph. Firstly, we construct a knowledge graph by extracting entities, properties and relationships from open source datasets. Secondly, the method based on dictionary technology and Aho-Corasick (AC) automaton is used to realize fast entity recognition and question word extraction. Then a problem base is established for problem template matching. Finally, we use query statements to retrieve answers in the graph database. In the military field, experiments show that through the framework proposed in this paper, a more comprehensive target graph can be quickly constructed, on this basis, accurate QA can be realized.

articleTitle: Locally Linear Embedding Based on t-Distribution Grasshopper Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Locally linear embedding (LLE) is a classical nonlinear dimensionality reduction algorithm for manifold learning in the field of machine learning (ML). The main idea of LLE is to pursue the linear isomorphism in the algebraic relationship between high-dimensional spatial data and low-dimensional spatial data after dimensionality reduction, and obtain the projection points of low-dimensional space by solving two optimization sub-problems. The optimization part of LLE is usually solved by gradient descent (GD) method. however, GD method has many disadvantages, such as easy to fall into the trap of local minimum, the closer to the optimal solution, the easier it is to show sawtooth effect. In order to overcome the above difficulties, in this paper, an LLE based on t-distribution grasshopper optimization algorithm has been proposed, it uses t-distribution grasshopper optimization algorithm which is a gradient independent swarm intelligence algorithm to replace GD for parameter optimization. Via numerical experiment, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm has been proved.

articleTitle: Study of cognitive activity in AI-augmented design iteration support
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: As a repetition of cognitive activities occurring in designers' thinking process, mental iteration is considered to be a natural feature of a designer's competency. Although the utilization of mental iteration is believed to increase the efficiency of the design process and lead to better quality solutions, the current understanding of it is still limited. This paper presents coding categories that were developed from a study on graphic design behavior. An experiment is conducted to study the effect of AI-augmented on the behavior of mental iteration. The results indicate AI-augment increases the frequency of cognitive activities in design iterations.

articleTitle: Treading accident analysis of phnom penh DIA bridge based on pathfinder
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In view of the problem that crowded stampede is easy to occur on the sightseeing bridge during the holiday peak period. Taking the stampede accident on the diamond bridge in Phnom Penh, Cambodia in 2010 as an example, this paper uses Pathfinder simulation software to establish the main body of the model, and sets three different scenarios of relative flow, one-way flow and emergency evacuation flow. Finally, the statistics and analysis of crowd density, regional risk and other data are carried out. The experimental results show that the risk degree in the middle of the bridge is higher than that of the two bridgeheads, and the east bridge head is more dangerous than the west bridge head, and the stampede accident is more likely to occur. The establishment of convective evacuation channel can shorten the evacuation time by 23 % and greatly reduce the probability of accidents.

articleTitle: Towards a data-driven assistance system for operating segment erectors in tunnel boring machines
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In tunnel construction, heavy machinery like tunnel boring machines are used to increase the safety and efficiency of tunneling projects. Despite the fact that these machines are equipped with a variety of different sensors, human workers still operate both the advance and ring building phases of the machine. Due to the high complexity of handling segment erectors, the ring building phase in particular has a lot of room for improvement. In this work, a concept of a data-driven assistance system to support operators in the ring building process is proposed. Three approaches to extract human expertise from operational data of tunnel boring machines using machine learning and explainable artificial intelligence are presented and discussed. Furthermore, preliminary data preprocessing results verify that our approach of determining ring building times is more accurate compared to on-site measurements. This contribution highlights the untouched potential of ring building optimization using machine learning techniques based on real-world data.

articleTitle: Text Line Segmentation Algorithm for Dongba Pictograph Document
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Text line segmentation is an important preprocessing work for Dongba document analysis. It is the basis of analysis and collection work such as character segmentation, Dongba pictograph extraction, Dongba pictograph translation and annotation segmentation, and sample collection. Combining with the structural characteristics of Dongba hieroglyphic documents, we give a text line segmentation algorithm which is suitable for Dongba hieroglyphic documents. The algorithm combines K-means clustering on the basis of projection segmentation to realize the automatic determination of the height range of a single text line. At the same time, it also realizes the automatic segmentation of too large or too small text blocks. This will lay the foundation for the automatic collection of Dongba pictographs and the completion of further research on Dongba documents.

articleTitle: Adaptive narrowband interference suppression technology based on compressed sensing
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to achieve information security and reliable transmission, the compressed sensing theory is applied to the narrowband interference suppression problem. It can effectively achieve narrowband interference suppression. However, the existing narrowband interference suppression schemes of compressed sensing have some disadvantages. Such as low efficiency of interference suppression module, low accuracy of reconstruction algorithm and need to know the sparsity as a priori information. In view of the above shortcomings, the narrowband interference identification module is designed to improve the system processing efficiency. Based on the sparse adaptive matching pursuit (SAMP) algorithm. This paper introduces the idea of changing step size by stages and proposes an improved zap sparse adaptive matching pursuit (ZSAMP)algorithm. Theoretical analysis and simulation show that the new algorithm is better than the existing typical greedy iterative algorithm under the same conditions. The signal sparsity is not overestimated and the running time is lower than the similar algorithm.

articleTitle: Content-based Remote Sensing Image Retrieval Based on Ant Colony Optimization and Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Content-based Remote sensing image retrieval (CBRSIR) methods usually only use the distance between a query image and retrieved images to retrieve and neglect the semantic similarity among images on the retrieval dataset during the retrieval process. The semantic similarity of these retrieved images helps improve the performance of CBRSIR. Hence, we propose a new retrieval method based on ant colony optimization (ACO) to use the semantic similarity between these retrieved images. The pheromone concentration is used to measure the semantic similarity between these retrieved images for improving retrieval performance. We first present how to initial the pheromone concentration of images. Next, we construct retrieval paths by mimicking the foraging process of ants and use a CNN regression model to accurately evaluate the length of these paths. Then, we update the pheromone concentration of images according to the length of the paths. Finally, we integrate the pheromone of images into the process of CBRSIR for improving retrieval performance. Experiments are conducted on a publicly available remote sensing image (UCMD) dataset. Compared with the state-of-the-art methods, the proposed method can improve retrieval precision.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Wind Turbine Clutter for Metric-Band Bistatic Radar
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The clutter generated by wind turbine rotation is difficult to be suppressed by conventional radar clutter suppression methods, which seriously affects the detection performance of radar. Wind turbine clutter modeling is the vital basis of clutter analysis and suppression. Aiming at the metric-band bistatic radar system, the azimuth and pitch angles between the transmitter, receiver and the wind turbine are considered in this paper. The scattering point integral algorithm is used to model the wind turbine clutter. The clutter characteristics are studied through simulation from three aspects: time domain, frequency domain and time-frequency domain. The clutter distribution at different speeds of wind turbine and different wavelengths of radar is also analyzed, which provides a theoretical basis for clutter suppression.

articleTitle: Genetic Programming-based Heuristic Generation Algorithm for Steelmaking - Continuous Casting Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper deals with the special mixed flow shop scheduling problem of steelmaking and continuous casting, establishing the SCC production scheduling solution framework based on charge sequencing rules and device assignment rules, and proposing a heuristic generation algorithm of SCC based on GP. The algorithm can automatically generate scheduling heuristic rules suitable for production scenarios. The simulation experiment is carried out with the actual production data of one refining steel mill, The experimental results show that the scheduling rules generated by the heuristic generation algorithm based on GP have better performance than the benchmarking rules in actual production environment, and with the increase of examples, the performance advantage of generated rules are more obvious and stable.

articleTitle: Multi-load AGVs scheduling algorithm in automated sorting warehouse
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Aiming at the multi-load AGVs scheduling problem in automated sorting warehouse, a two-stage heuristic algorithm is proposed with the optimization goal of minimizing the maximum handling completion time. In the first stage of the algorithm, the similarity between different packages is defined and a clustering algorithm based on package similarity is proposed to divide the packages into several groups, so that the packages contained in each group can be sorted by a multi-load AGV in one operation. In the second stage of the algorithm, a scheduling algorithm based on the idea of load balancing is designed to assign and sort the divided package groups. The efficiency and robustness of the proposed algorithm are verified by different scale computational experiments.

articleTitle: Metamorphic Relationship Generation Based on t-Distribution Zeroth-Order Optimization Method
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Metamophic testing is an important method in software testing, and the generation of metamorphic relationship is just the key to metamorphic testing. However, there are some difficulties in generating the metamorphic relationship itself. Its loss function has item(s) defined by L1 norm, which means that it contains the absolute value item(s) and makes the whole problem be a non differentiable non-smooth optimization one. Thus, the conventional gradient related line search method cannot be used to find the optimal solution of the metamorphic relationship generation. Therefore, in this paper, a metamorphic relationship generation method based on t-distribution zero-order (ZO, a derivative free optimization algorithm) optimization method has been proposed, the traditional gradient solution process has been replaced by a gradient estimator obtained by the very t-distribution ZO optimization method, and the line search framework is used to solve the optimal solution of the non-smooth optimization loss function in metamorphic relationship generation.

articleTitle: DNN-Based Speech Separation with Joint Improved Distortion Constraints
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Considering that in different signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) regions, the amplification distortion caused by the overestimation of the gain function will have varying degrees of impact on the speech intelligibility, this paper proposes a deep neural network (DNN) speech separation with joint improved distortion constraints to further improve speech intelligibility. The algorithm first uses the segmented SNR to correct the overestimated gain function, and then combines the constraints of amplification distortion to further constrain the output amplitude of the estimated speech to obtain the final separated speech. Finally, the comparative experiments show that the proposed algorithm can significantly improve the speech quality and intelligibility of the separated speech.

articleTitle: Dongba Scripture Segmentation Algorithm Based on Discrete Curve Evolution
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Text line segmentation is an important preprocessing work for Dongba document analysis. It is the basis of analysis and collection work such as character segmentation, Dongba pictograph extraction, Dongba pictograph translation and annotation segmentation, and sample collection.
