The algorithm combines K-means clustering on the basis of projection segmentation to realize the automatic determination of the height range of a single text line. At the same time, it also realizes the automatic segmentation of too large or too small text blocks. This will lay the foundation for the automatic collection of Dongba pictographs and the completion of further research on Dongba documents.

articleTitle: THE Furnace temperature curve based on one-dimensional unsteady heat conduction model
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the change rule of center temperature of welding zone in backwelding furnace under different set temperature and transfer rate conditions, and searches for appropriate temperature and rate to obtain the optimal furnace temperature curve. Different infinite length plate models were established for the small temperature region and interval respectively, and the heat transfer of each part was considered according to Fourier heat law and Newton cooling law, and the equation about the temperature change with time was constructed based on the law of energy conservation.

articleTitle: Study on the Hyper-Spectral Image Characteristics of Liquid Stains in Waste Textiles
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Global growth in textile products has brought great economic value while producing a large amount of waste textiles. At present, the technical bottleneck appears in the identification stage of the recycling of waste textiles, so it is urgent to study and explore a new identification system. Based on the basis of determining the types and types of existing waste textiles, this paper analyzes the main types of pollutants contained in waste textiles, studies the characteristics of stained waste textiles and stain-free fabric, and explores the possibility to quickly identify waste textile pollutants using high-spectral imaging system. Following conclusions are attained: Liquid stains do not lead to the occurrence of characteristic peaks, but reduce the reflectivity at the reflectivity/wavelength high-spectral curve; the greater the concentration, the more the curve decreases than the stain -free original sample curve.

articleTitle: Virtual matching measurement of gap and flush
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: As two parameters of evaluating automobile assembly quality, gap and flush directly affects the overall appearance, sealing, switching fluency and wind noise of automobile body. Therefore, clearance surface difference of automobile assembly parts must be strictly controlled.Because of the complexity in the actual measurement of clearance surface difference, this paper presents a method of measurement of gap and flush based on virtual matching. The experimental results show that the measurement method is basically consistent with the actual measurement, where the efficiency is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Research on the target cargo identification method based on CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The automatic inspection robot can effectively pre-vent cargo from being stolen, replaced and opened without authorization. However, it will be disturbed by external factors such as occlusion, illumination and angle when it takes photos to identify cargo, which will affect the recognition effect. In order to improve the recognition effect of the automatic inspection robot on the target goods, this paper first detects the object in the data preprocessing stage, extracts the goods con-tour, and then carries on the image recognition, which im-proves the recognition rate. Then we compare the loss rate and accuracy rate of four network models: AlexNet, GoogleNet, ResNet and MobileNet. The experimental results show that ResN et algorithm has the highest image recognition accuracy, is more friendly to the recognition of light and occlusion, and is more in line with the actual operation needs of automatic inspection robot. It has reference value for the research of target cargo recognition.

articleTitle: Heuristic algorithm of steel coil cutting with manufacturability
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Taking into account the material utilization rate and processing convenience to solve the blanking problem is the basis for the intelligent manufacturing. Aiming at the two-dimensional blanking problem with steel coils as raw materials and rectangular parts as finished products, an optimized blanking algorithm for steel coils based on manufacturability is proposed. This algorithm first use the recursive algorithm to generate the pattern that meets the maximum value of the current coil section. Then, call the cutting generation algorithm cyclically until all the requirements are met. In the meantime, the value of the part was constantly revised to prevent the algorithm from falling into local optimum. During the pattern generation process, only homogeneous strips are allowed to give full play to the advantages of co-edge cutting. Finally, experiments verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in improving material utilization and simplifying processing technology.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Hollowness on the Dynamic Characteristics of Marine Shaft System
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to study the influence of hollowness of marine shaft system change on the vibration characteristics of shafting alignment, this paper takes the shafting of a test bench as the object, combines the finite element method and co-simulation, and takes the hollowness of the stern shaft as the independent variable to complete the static shafting. Mechanics and dynamics calculations, and further analysis of the inherent properties and dynamics of the marine shaft system with hollowness, the research results can provide new theoretical support for the selection of shaft diameter and marine shaft system design optimization.

articleTitle: Probability and standpoint based argumentation framework
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The abstract argumentation framework has become a core research in knowledge representation and artificial intelligence. Many extend argumentation frameworks proposed, while they have not referred to standpoint. In this paper, we propose the probability and standpoint based argumentation framework. The concept of standpoint is defined to represent the viewpoint of argument. We provide the semantics and properties of the probability and standpoint based argumentation.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of intelligent RGV simulation scheduling system based on simulated annealing algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: By establishing a mathematical model, the intelligent RGV scheduling scheme is optimized to design an efficient and stable intelligent RGV simulation scheduling system. This paper studies two different situations, including whether there is a fault in a process. Using the combination of high response ratio priority scheduling algorithm and simulated annealing algorithm, the process conditions including two or more process package faults are established, an intelligent RGV simulation scheduling algorithm based on simulated annealing is proposed, and the general intelligent RGV simulation scheduling system model is established. At the end of the paper, the failure of the two processes is also analyzed, and similar solutions can be given on the basis of this paper.

Author Keywords: High response ratio priority scheduling algorith

articleTitle: Study on wearability of light-weight and broken weft denim
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, we designed a kind of weft backed weave denim fabric. Two experimental factors were designed:structure and weft density. Six denim samples were prepared according to the whole scheme sample design, and tested crease recovery, moisture permeability, air permeability, drapability of the sample. Using a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method studied on the relationship between wearability, fabric structure and weft density. The results show that the crease recovery, moisture permeability, air permeability, drapability of the sample is better. When the face weave is 1/7 right twill and the weft density is 20 yarn/cm, the crease recovery, moisture permeability and air permeability of the sample was better. when the face weave is 1/5 right twill and the weft density is 25 yarn/cm.the drapability of the sample was better. When the face weave is 1/5 right twill, the back weave is plain weave and the weft density is 20 yarn/cm.the wearability of light-weight and broken weft denim is better. The purpose of this study is to explore a better wearability scheme of light-weight and broken weft denim, and provide some reference for the development of new denim.

articleTitle: Research on the Cultivation of Food-saving Habits Based on Behavioral Design
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Food waste has become a major global concern. In order to effectively reduce food waste, users need to cultivate the habit of saving food. It analyzes the reasons why users waste food from the behavioral level, and proposes a food-saving interactive design strategy based on the FBM behavior model. By analyzing the current situation of food waste in the target group and users' attitudes, behaviors, and psychology towards food waste, combined with questionnaires, interviews, etc., quantitative and qualitative analysis are carried out, and the user's food waste links in catering and different scenarios are summarized. The amount of food wastage and the problems caused by food waste. Combining the FBM behavior model, an interactive design method for cultivating food-saving habits is proposed from three aspects: enhancing user motivation, improving user capabilities, and increasing trigger mechanisms. Interactive design methods such as immersive experience, timely and effective feedback, interesting game interactions, incentive mechanisms, and diversified choices can effectively promote users' understanding of food sources, growth and other knowledge, and cultivate knowledge in an interesting form, so that users can personally experience the hard-won food in the bowl, and then cultivate the user's sense of responsibility and mission to save food, and finally develop a good habit of saving food.

articleTitle: A Novel Low Training Cost SSVEP Detector Design
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Over the past years, steady-state visual evoked potentials (SSVEP) has been widely used in brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) due to its high efficiency, robustness and noninvasive. The supervised SSVEP detector attracted the attention of researchers for its high information transfer rate (ITR). However, the tedious training process restricted its extensive application. This study proposed a low-training cost SSVEP detector with a dynamic window strategy. By this method, the users only need to collect 40-s training data and can achieve a high performance. A 40-target data set was employed to evaluate the performance of the proposed method. The results indicated that the proposed method can achieve 177.5 bits/min ITR, which is 11.2% higher than filter bank canonical correlation analysis with dynamic window (FBCCA-DW).

articleTitle: Analysis of the effect of objective function on the performance of the algorithm for the inverse kinematic of manipulator
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to analyze the influence of the objective function on the algorithm, we compare the common definitions of objective functions and propose a piecewise objective function definition method based on error value to further improve the algorithm performance. Using classical swarm intelligence optimization algorithms such as DE, MABC, PSO, three types of objective functions are contrast analyzed on a 6-degree-of-freedom (DOF) underwater manipulator model to verify the superiority of the improved objective function. The results show that the improved objective function performs well in solving the inverse kinematic of the 6-DOF underwater manipulator, which is reflected in that the objective function is insensitive to the algorithm and the rod of the manipulator. That is, the improved objective function is more stable, and the proportion of the posture error to the specified accuracy is higher. The objective function definition method of adaptive weight proposed in this paper is an effective and suitable definition method for multi-DOF manipulators.

articleTitle: Study on the design of graduate education management system based on design thinking
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This paper analyzes the deficiencies in the design of the current postgraduate education management system, proposes new ideas for the interactive design of the postgraduate education management system under the guidance of the principle of design thinking. Data collection and comparative analysis are carried out on the current situation of the Chinese graduate education management system, and through interviews and questionnaires we collected information about teachers' and students' opinion of the current system. Through SPSS regression analysis, combined with interview records, we found the main problems of the current system on interactive design and function design. Based on the design thinking theory, the improvement method of the system is proposed, which can make the process of communication and interaction between teachers and students more effective, with the goal to improve the quality of postgraduate education as a tool of academic research.

articleTitle: Study on the development model of design museums based on grounded theory
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to crack the black box model of design museums, this paper conducted complete research of design museums, and putting forward opinions and suggestions for the establishment of design museums in China. Based on the grounded theory, through the exploratory study of 10 famous design museums worldwide, this paper analyzes the cultural design collection, cultural design creation and design culture communication activities carried out by the design museum with the goal of promoting the involvement of design culture in social life, as well as the measures, resources and effects taken by the design museum in these activities. In the process of design museum's involvement in social life, its core function is design collection, design research, design exhibition, design education and the formation of social influence. Putting the study results under the background of Chinese design culture, this paper puts forward “an ideal model for Chinese design museum to intervene in social life”, and makes some suggestions for the construction of design museums in China.

articleTitle: A Method for improving Data Quality of Large-scale Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Data quality has always been a concern for both system developers and users, especially in recent years, the accuracy and reliability of data in the application of some large simulation systems are becoming more and more imporant. Based on the six-grade scale model, firstly this paper sets on an index hierarchy of data quality evaluation and its weights, in order to understand the comprehensive status of large-scale simulation system data quality, then based on pearl curve function establishes data fitting model, and from the curve which we got can be directly seen the relationship between funding strength and data quality. At last based on the fund allocation model of genetic algorithm, we can promot the continuous improvement of the data quality, and further improve credibility of the large-scale large simulation system.

articleTitle: Color Analysis of Silk Fabrics Dyed Based on “The Qianlong Palette”
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Based on the Munsell color system and CIE LAB color system, this paper analyzes the color characteristics of dyed silk fabrics based on “The Qianlong Palette”, and finally determines the influence of concentration of dye liquor, Alum and black Alum, on the chromaticity characteristics of dyed silk fabrics. As a result, the dominant hue for a total of 210 naturally dyed silks fabrics was yellowish families followed by purple-blueness and reddish ones in the Munsell notation, without blueness and blue-greenish ones. We found that the lightness gradually decreases with the increase of the concentration of dye liquor. The value and chroma of all dyed silk fabrics are affected by alum and black alum which are likely to cause the value and chroma of most natural plant-dyed silk fabrics to decrease.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Improved Quality Control Model for Marine Shaft System Design
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the relation matrix is too subjective and the sample demand is too large in the existing quality control model for marine shaft system design, the relation matrixes are established by grey relational analysis method to calculate the weights of technical characteristic indexes and construction technology indexes, and on this basis, the improved quality control model for marine shaft system is constructed. Taking a shaft system design process as an example, the improved quality control model is built to provide scientific quality control basis for it, thus the effectiveness of the improved model is verified.

articleTitle: Mining Resident Activity Pattern Based on Spatio-temporal Trajectory Data
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The research on residents' activity pattern based on spatio-temporal trajectory data is helpful to the optimization of urban operation. At present, one of the difficulties in the research is how to determine the regularity of residents' activities when the labeled samples are sparse. We propose an improved periodic decision algorithm of sliding window, combined with feedforward neural network to search outlier activity patterns. Experimental results show that our method can effectively classify the overall travel features and quantify individual activity abnormalities.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Asynchronous Fault Tolerant Control for Semi-Markov Jump Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This work investigates the fault-tolerant control scheme for Takagi-Sugeno fuzzy semi-Markov jump systems with actuator faults. The hidden semi-Markov model is employed to describe the asynchronous phenomenon between the controller and plant. Based on Lyapunov theory, the fault tolerant controller depending on observable mode is presented to make sure that the semi-Markov jump systems is stochastically stable and satisfies the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$H_{\infty}$</tex> performance. A simulation example via a single-link robot is employed to prove the correctness of the studied approach.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Interaction of Interests in the Re-examination of Postgraduate Enrollment
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This article takes offering or accepting bribes in the re-examination of postgraduates as the research object and constructs a dynamic game model between enrollment decision-makers and re-examination candidates. It analyzes the bribery behavior and motives between re-examination candidates and enrollment decision-makers and explores the conditions for both parties of the game to reach an equilibrium outcome of not offering or accepting bribes. It proposes to appropriately reward re-examination candidates for their proactive whistleblowing behavior and the integrity of enrollment decision-makers, to severely punish corrupt behaviors, and to expand the transparency of enrollment decision, the right to know as well as the right to complaint.

articleTitle: More Love, More Behavioral Intention: Understanding Elderly's Acceptance of Smartphone Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In recent years, smartphones have been widely available, and an increasing number of people begin to use various applications to facilitate their daily life. Meanwhile, the aging of the world population is becoming more and more serious. Therefore, it is necessary to study the acceptance of smartphone applications among the elderly. In this study, an extended TAM model was established and 655 adults aged 55 and over were surveyed with questionnaires. Finally, 496 questionnaires were used. The results showed that anxiety, facilitating conditions, social influence, and self-efficacy have a significant impact on the elderly's acceptance of smartphone applications. In addition, social influence has been proved to be a key factor that affects use intention. Hence, providing the elderly with encouragement and support from family and friends to use smartphone applications may improve their behavioral intention. The results of this study provide suggestions and directions for future interaction design.

articleTitle: Research On Dynamic Characteristics of Ship Sliding Bearing Lubrication Based on Predictive Response Surface
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: For the prediction of bearing liquid film dynamic lubrication, the elastic basic boundary conditions of the ship's shafting is considered, the finite element method is used to obtain the displacement between the journal and the sleeve, and the problem of liquid film lubrication characteristics is solved when the journal and the shaft sleeve are relatively deflected. Based on the two-dimensional Reynolds equation, the distribution law of the bearing liquid film is obtained, and the difference method and the over-relaxation iterative method are combined to obtain the equivalent support characteristics of the bearing under steady state. Finally, the least square method and convolutional neural network are used to for deep learning and establishment of bearing support characteristics response surface. The predicted response surface can be used as a model basis for shaft rotor dynamics and dynamic calibration.

articleTitle: Mean-absolute semi-deviation-skewness-sine entropy portfolio selection model based on credibility theory
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this paper, a portfolio selection problem is discussed. Firstly, based on the credibility theory, the rate of return of a security is regarded as a triangular fuzzy number and the variance is replaced by the rate's lower half variance of-absolute semi-deviation to express the portfolio risk, Thus, a mean-absolute semi-deviation --sine entropy portfolio selection model is proposed, in which cardinal constraints and threshold constraints are considered in a fuzzy random environment. Secondly, an Improved Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm (INSGA-II) is designed to solve the proposed model, in which a chaotic optimization strategy is added into when the population is initialized. And a crowding distance formula is introduced, in which the variance is considered. This can make the solution more efficient. Finally, the historical data of some stocks in the Shanghai 50 Index constituent stocks are selected for numerical analysis to prove the effectiveness of the proposed model and the algorithm.

articleTitle: KnHiGAN: Knowledge-enhanced Hierarchical Generative Adversarial Network for Fine-grained Text-to-Image Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: To generate fine-grained images with greater authenticity, in this paper, we propose a Knowledge-enhanced Hierarchical Generative Adversarial Network (KnHiGAN) for text-to-image synthesis. KnHiGAN sets up a Knowledge Enhancement Module to expand conditions for the limited text descriptions by combining with the knowledge graph, as a result, it can provide richer fine-grained details to the generative network. Moreover, a Hierarchical Generative Adversarial Network is designed to generate the foreground and background separately, and the two are integrated together to composite the final result. Experiments on CUB-200 and Oxford-102 datasets show that our KnHiGAN can not only generate the fine-grained images which are more like those that exist in the real world, but also can maintain a high degree of consistency with the original text input.

articleTitle: System Design of Detection and Intervention Methods for Apnea
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: According to the survey results of the World Health Organization, currently affected by the pressure of life and work, more than one-third of people worldwide have sleep problems of varying degrees. Among them, apnea can cause hypoxia in the brain and body, the heart is loaded with work, and even sudden death is prone to occur. In response to this phenomenon, this article designed a apnea detection and intervention inflatable pillow based on the STM32 embed-ded system combined with signal detection, voice processing, and data transmission technology. Analyze the collected sleep sounds of users. If it is judged to be snoring or apnea, the main control CPU controls the peripheral device to inflate and deflate the airbag inside the pillow, change the neck pitch angle, make the airway unobstructed, and relieve snoring symptom. It can also record the user's snoring data and provide corresponding reference data for future diagnosis and treatment. After experimental tests, the working condition is good.

articleTitle: Research on Innovative Elements of Product Appearance Design in International Intellectual Property Rights - Taking Furniture Design as an Example
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: At present, intellectual property disputes of Chinese products often occur in the world. In this paper, the domestic and foreign cases of design infringement in the field of design laws and furniture are studied, and the methods of innovation in design are summarized, such as the change of overall modeling language, reasonable avoidance of functional design, and extraction of modeling elements from culture. According to the method, the children's growth desk with intellectual property rights was designed. The purpose of this study is to find a set of reasonable methods for the design innovation of Chinese products, to make Chinese products more competitive in the international market and gain higher international recognition.

articleTitle: Analysis of Inter-turn Short Circuit Magnetic Field of Dry-type Air-core Reactor Based on Maxwell
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Dry-type air-core reactors are prone to inter-turn short circuit faults under long-term operation, which poses a serious threat to the safe operation of the power system. In response to this problem, this paper establishes an equivalent circuit model of the inter-turn short circuit based on the structural and electrical characteristics of the dry-type air-core reactor and simulates and analyzes the magnetic field distribution before and after the reactor fault through Maxwell software. Through research, the distribution law of the overall magnetic field before and after the reactor fault and the change law of the local magnetic flux density at different short-circuit fault locations of the same winding are obtained. The experimental simulation results in this paper provide a theoretical basis for the detection method of the short-circuit magnetic field of the reactor and also provide a reference for the stable operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: Subway Passenger Flow Statistics Method Based on Flexible Force-sensitive Sensors
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The flexible force-sensitive sensor can obtain detailed shoe print trajectory information of passers-by, which has important application value. This study proposes a method of subway passenger flow statistics based on trajectory tracking. The method includes shoe print extraction, parameter calculation, and trajectory tracking. Firstly, the complete shoe print is extracted and merged using clustering algorithm; then various parameters are calculated based on the shape of the shoe print and walking time. Finally, the footprint tracking is performed according to the walking habits of pedestrians. The experimental results show that the method has good performance in passenger flow statistics. It is promising to be applied to the statistics at the platform outside the subway doors.

articleTitle: Sliding mode control of the temperature of a nonlinear plate heat exchange system
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Based on the working process and principles of a plate heat exchange system, a set of differential equations to control the temperature of the system was deduced. Based on analysis and calculation using FLUENT fluid simulation software, as well as repeated experiments using an experimental platform, mathematical expressions for the variable parameters, such as the temperature difference between cold and hot water and the heat transfer coefficient in the equation set, were determined. In the heat exchange model, the temperature of the cold water entering the heat exchanger and the temperature of the hot water exiting the heat exchanger were taken as the state variables, and the degree of opening of the electric control valves for the open-and closed-circulating cold water were taken as the control inputs. The system showed characteristics typical of a multi-input coupled nonlinear system. Using the method of solving the multi-input nonlinear system in the sliding mode variable structure theory, the model was studied as a type of multi-input affine nonlinear system, and the sliding mode variable structure controller was solved. Simulation research using MATLAB/Simulink was carried out on the nonlinear plate heat exchange control system. The results showed that sliding mode variable structure control had several advantages, including limited overshoot, rapid response speed, and strong anti-interference ability.

articleTitle: Testing on Anti-jamming Performance of Tracking Loop for Frequency Hopping System
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Frequency Hopping (FH) system is widely researched by its strong anti-jamming performance. Focusing on the common jamming of tracking loop for FH system, the typical jamming signal features are analyzed, which including full-band jamming, partial-band jamming and tracking jamming signals. The anti-jamming performance of the synchronous tracking loop on FH system is tested, which focused on the modulation of QPSK. Simulation testing results shows that FH system has strong anti-full-band jamming and anti-partial-band jamming performance, the system has weak anti-single-tone-tracking jamming and anti-double-tone-tracking jamming performance, and the anti-tracking jamming performance will be weaker with the DTR increasing of the jamming signal.

articleTitle: Factors Affecting Adoption of Heytea Based on SICAS Model
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Heytea pioneered the digitization of Chinese beverage chains by leveraging social apps like WeChat, Weibo, etc. Due to the trend of consumption upgrades, it is observed that consumers are having more demand for the bubble tea chain industry. Based on SICAS and TAM, the research constructs a theoretical model of consumers' consumption factors, summarizes the existing problems, and suggests the corresponding solutions. This study provides a new perspective on bubble tea chains.

articleTitle: Design Semantic Typicality Calculation in Conceptual Spaces
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The assessment of typicality is a vital aspect of design evaluations. Based on the theories of fuzzy semantic cell and feature prototype model (FPM), we proposed an objective method to measure design semantic typicality. Design semantic typicality was assessed based on the Euclidian distances between a design case and its prototype. It could be calculated by the mean distance between the prototypes of design features and the prototype of the benchmark category in conceptual spaces. We validate this method in two experiments. Based on the analysis of empirical and experimental results, we confirmed that the proposed method is a promising approach to quantify design semantic typicality, which is able to largely reflect the human perception of design typicality.

articleTitle: A Customer Preference-centered Method of Exhibition Design Trend Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In exhibition design, there is usually a difference between the design intention and the customer's actual experience. Therefore, it is necessary to incorporate customer preferences into the design strategy generation system. This article proposes a customer preference-centered trend forecasting method for exhibition design, and verifies its feasibility through a case study. This method is based on a set of standardized procedures, including fitting the relationship between customer preferences and design features, and trend prediction based on historical data. The article aims to support the proposal of user preference-centered design strategies, eliminate the perception difference between designers and customers, and provide guidance for practical applications.

articleTitle: Intelligent speaker design from the perspective of traditional wood structure construction and protection
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Focusing on the adaptive dilemma faced by traditional architectural craftsmanship for timber-framed structures in the intelligent era, this paper redesigns the smart home products that fit the traditional wooden structure atmosphere. Summarize the modernization path of existing wood structure construction skills, integrate perceptual engineering into product design, analyze users' perceptual needs, dig out the perceptual image in the design of smart speaker in the context of wood structure construction culture, and transform the perceptual elements of smart speaker modeling into design elements. The research aims at effectively and reasonably extracting design elements from users' perceptual experience, providing new ideas for s smart home product design, and helping traditional skills to break through the survival dilemma and create a modern development space.

articleTitle: Effect comparative analysis of wavelet reconstruction and EMD data processing in continuous shock signal interference
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: When the mechanical structure is subjected to a very short interval of continuous shock, the shocked machine will oscillate, the shocked force value cannot be measured accurately, the later shock force value will be affected by the former shock force. In this paper, in order to eliminate the interference caused by mechanical self-oscillation in the shock force test, two signal processing algorithms were adopted, which conclude wavelet reconstruction algorithm and empirical mode decomposition (EMD). Through the analysis in time domain and frequency domain, it is found that both algorithms can eliminate the interference effectively, which caused by mechanical self-oscillation. These processing effects are the same.

articleTitle: Study on comfort performance of hyaluronic acid viscose fiber seamless knitted fabric for autumn and winter
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In this study,to explore the comfort of hyaluronic acid viscose seamless knitted fabric,different veil interweaving ratios of hyaluronic and graphene viscoses and three different knitted fabric structures are taken as factors,18 samples of knitted fabrics are woven on a seamless knitting machine, and then the heat retention property, moisture regain and antistatic property of 18 samples of fabrics are tested.The results show that the best heat retention performance is hyaluronic acid / graphene viscose fiber fabric with 1+3 false rib structure, the best moisture regain and antistatic performance is hyaluronic acid / graphene viscose fiber fabric with weft flat needle structure.

articleTitle: Customer Satisfaction Analysis Based on User-Generated Content
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This article analyzes the evaluation of takeaway platform, and then conducts research on the satisfaction distribution of reviews of takeaway platform. Firstly, collect user-generated content on the delivery platform; secondly, use topic clustering to dig out the emotional topic, and build a corpus of food delivery reviews based on the sentences under the topic. Use TF-IDF to construct a takeaway sentiment dictionary which to analyze the user-generated takeaway evaluations to obtain customer satisfaction. The experimental results show that it is effective to first use LDA clustering to mark the data to construct a corpus, and then use the corpus to construct a dictionary.

articleTitle: Service Design of Sex Education for the Disabled
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: According to statistics, there are 650 million people with disabilities worldwide, 80% of whom are in developing countries. In China alone, there are more than 85 million. In recent years, the trend of human rights and humanitarianism has changed society's attitude towards the disabled from discrimination to respect and support. The barriers between the disabled and the non-disabled are gradually removed, and more and more high-tech products to assist the life of the disabled are constantly iterating. We work to bring people with disabilities closer to normal people, but there is one area that has been neglected - the sexual needs of people with disabilities. The public's neglect of their sexual needs is also the result of stereotypes that. Liu argues that sexuality and disability may seem far apart, and it is often assumed that people with disabilities do not have the same sexual needs as normal people and are simply incapable of exercising their sexual functions. Society and culture always conceal many negative assumptions and attitudes towards the sexuality of people with disabilities. Disabled people tend to be mostly portrayed in a negative light in popular culture, which undermines their sexual rights and roles. In a sense, the sexuality of people with disabilities is not an individual physical problem, but a socio-cultural one.

articleTitle: Design of Predictive Controller for UAV Track Tracking Model
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of track tracking during UAV flight, this paper designs the controller based on the model predictive control theory of full state feedback. First, the disturbance error model is established with reference to the body model and linearized and discretized it. Secondly, the linear quadratic programming method is used to solve the optimal control sequence. The simulation results show that the controller designed in this paper can accurately track the UAV's nominal trajectory, and at the same time can effectively suppress the external interference during the flight.

articleTitle: Measurement Method of Thermal Conductivity of Fabrics Based on TPS and MTPS
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to explore the accuracy and correlation of measuring the thermal conductivity of fabrics by plane source technology and transient method, 21 pure fabrics and blended fabrics with different fiber components were selected in the market, and two different testing methods were studied, induding transient plane method (TPS) and improved transient plane method (MTPS). We measured the thermal conductivity of fabrics by Hot disk and TCI thermal conductivity meter and discussed Pearson correlation between the two plane source testing methods by mathematical analysis, and then compared with the thermal conductivity of fiber materials. The results show that the thermal conductivity of fabric tested by TCI has a small variation range; The difference value of thermal conductivity between Hot disk and TCI is small, and the average difference is 0.0089176, less than 0.01, which shows that the data of the two methods are consistent; At the same time, it is found that the data values of the two methods have obvious correlation (0.812) at the level of 0.01 (double tail), which indicates the reliability of testing the thermal conductivity of fabrics by transient plane source method; Fiber composition has great influence on the thermal conductivity of fabrics. The thermal conductivity of fabrics with the same fiber composition and different blending ratios is not much different, but there are some differences, which vary within a small order of magnitude; Finally, it is found that there are obvious differences between the thermal conductivity of fabric and that of fiber materials due to the influence of fabric structure, static air volume and moisture absorption.

articleTitle: Research on Steelmaking-Continuous Casting Scheduling Problem with Uncertain Processing Times
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the process of steelmaking-continuous casting production, the processing time which is affected by various disturbance factors, is uncertain. To improve the feasibility of the initial scheduling scheme, the robust optimization method was adopted. A robust optimization scheduling model was built with the objective of minimizing the total waiting time by introducing a bounded uncertain set of processing time. Based on this model, a hybrid encoding genetic algorithm was proposed to solve it, and two crossover and mutation operators were designed. The simulation experiment was designed based on actual production data of the steel plant, and the results showed the effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: Analysis of Compensation Effect of Balance Lateral Force Under Multiple Harmonic Interference
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: When the lateral excitation is applied to the balance, the natural frequency of the mechanism tested by accelerometer and balance was more complex. It was not a signal frequency signal. The spectrum of the two channels that measure lateral forces was inconsistent, and the same result was obtained after repeated experiment. In this paper, the wavelet reconstruction technology is used to filter the high harmonic interference signal in the accelerometer measurement signal, and then the projection equation was used to compensate the lateral signal before the balance signal combination, so as to prevent the interference signal from being amplified in the balance channel combination. The results show that the positive, zero and the negative angles of attack have different compensation effects. The dispersion of compensation coefficient was small when the angle of attack was positive and zero, and the dispersion of compensation coefficient was large when the angle of attack was negative.

articleTitle: Study on Intelligent Design of Wooden Structure Urban Furniture in China
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Based on analysis on the future demand and development direction of urban furniture, this paper summarizes the innovative design methods of wood structure in future urban furniture. The combination of modern transformation of traditional wooden structure and the innovation of intelligent function of urban furniture brings the development direction and possible appearance of future wooden structure urban furniture. The urban furniture design case following centers on innovative connection nodes and the use of wooden structure as the main frame, while making the design adapted to the future development trend of intelligent city through intelligent function design as well. The purpose of this study is to modernize and redesign traditional wood structure construction technique in urban furniture design to adapt it to future city development.

articleTitle: An optimization method for rush order insertion rescheduling problem under the constraints of hot rolling process
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: The production process of hot rolling stage is complex, which has strict rolling requirements for the change of slab specifications. Disturbance factors such as rush order insertion are very common in hot rolling production, which will lead to the initial scheduling scheme cannot continue to execute, and then destroy the production continuity. In the paper, an optimization method for the rush order insertion rescheduling was proposed for such disturbance factors as rush orders. Firstly, in order to improve product quality and production continuity, under the constraints of hot rolling process, the rescheduling model for rush order insertion is established to minimize the sum of slab jump penalties. Furthermore, the estimation of distribution algorithm based on the rush order insertion rescheduling problem was designed. The coding method and probability model were designed for this paper. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the model and algorithm are verified by simulation experiments with actual production data.

articleTitle: Comparing Performance and Efficiency of Designers and Design Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Intelligent design has been an emerging important area in the design. Existing works related to intelligent design use objective indicators to measure the quality of AI design by comparing the differences between AI-generated data and real data. However, the level of quality and efficiency of intelligent design compared to human designers remains unclear. We conducted user experiments to compare the design quality and efficiency of advanced design methods with that of junior designers. The conclusion is advanced intelligent design methods are comparable with junior designers on painting. Besides, intelligent design uses only 10% of the time spent by the junior designer in the tasks of layout design, color matching, and video editing.

articleTitle: Hilbert Fractal-based HMS Improves the Efficiency of Wireless Power Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: To further improve the power efficiency of wireless power transfer(WPT) systems, a hybrid metamaterial slab (HMS) consisting of the 3rd-order Hilbert fractal spiral resonator with magnetic permeability tending to 0 and -1 is proposed. The HMS is applied to a WPT system with an operating frequency of 6.78 MHz. The effect of the Hilbert fractal-based hybrid metamaterial on the WPT system is explored through theoretical analysis and simulation verification. The simulation results show that the incorporation of the Hilbert fractal-based HMS can improve the power efficiency of the WPT system with a transmission distance of 0.4m by 17.57%.

articleTitle: Improved Ant Colony System for Cast Planning Problem with Consideration of On-line Mould Width Adjustment
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Cast planning problem is the basis of steelmaking-continuous casting (SCC) scheduling. The paper focuses on the cast planning problem and adjusts the constraints of the traditional model which is idealization. Considering the application of on-line mold width adjustment in actual production, the paper reconstructs the model with the goal of minimizing the total planning cost, then establishes a cast planning model that considers on-line mold width adjustment, transforms it into a vehicle routing problem (VRP). An improved ant colony system (IACS) based on rules such as node sorting rule and node transfer rule is designed to solve the problem. The efficiency of the proposed algorithm are verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Study on wearability of far infrared seamless knitted fabric
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the acceleration of the pace of modern life.many people are suffering from chronic disease[1]. Because of its physiological effects such as improving microcirculation and strengthening metabolism, far infrared fabric is widely used in the weaving of intimate clothing to alleviate diseases related to auxiliary treatment. Therefore, it is very important to explore the wearing comfort performance of far infrared fabric. In this paper, by designing two kinds of knitted fabric structure, six kinds of far-infrared Chinlon fiber yarns were selected to compared with ordinary Chinlon yarns. According to the experimental method of the whole test, 14 samples of knitted fabric are woven on the seamless knitting machine, and the warmth preservation, moisture absorption, moisture permeability and air permeability of the fabric are explored by the method of comparative evaluation. The results showed that the veil of different yarn composition effect for seamless knitted fabric to keep warm, breathable, moisture absorption, moisture permeability, the main factors of fabric structure, when the veil components in coffee polyamide or bamboo charcoal fiber, carbon for jersey seamless knitted fabric structure, has good moisture absorption, when the veil components in metal germanium polyamide, for jersey seamless knitted fabric structure, It has good moisture permeability. When the veil is composed of graphene Chinlon and the structure is 1 +3 false rib seamless knitted fabric, it has good heat retention and air permeability.

articleTitle: Research on Curriculum Reform of Circuit and Electronic Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Based on current teaching situation of circuit and electronic technology, the paper determines the teaching philosophy of student-centered, results oriented and continuous improvement, and reconstructs the course content of electrical and electronic technology combined with the internet of things engineering. What's more, a comprehensive experimental project which named intelligent tracking car is designed so as to stimulate students' learning interest and cultivate students' innovative spirit. Finally, the reform method of electronic and electrical technology is put forward, which provides a useful reference for the cultivation of application-oriented talents in application oriented university.

articleTitle: Study on the relationship between structure and appearance of hyaluronic acid viscose seamless knitted fabric used in summer
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In order to explore the appearance properties of hyaluronic acid viscose seamless knitted fabric, this study took the material types of hygroscopic and sweat - absorbing yarn in the veil, the arrangement ratio of hyaluronic acid viscose yarn and hygroscopic and sweat - absorbing yarn in the veil and the fabric structure as test factors to design the sample scheme. According to the orthogonal test design, 16 fabric samples were obtained. Then the rigid flexibility, anti - pilling and wrinkling recovery of 16 samples were tested and analyzed. The results show that hyaluronic acid viscose yarns and diacetate yarns in the veil are arranged in a ratio of 75: 25, and the fabric with mesh structure has the lowest stiffness and flexibility. The type and arrangement ratio of veil materials have great influence on the anti - pilling performance of fabric, but the fabric structure has little influence. Hyaluronic acid viscose yarn and copper ammonia fiber yarn in the veil are arranged in a ratio of 75: 25, and the fabric with mesh structure has the best crease recovery performance.

articleTitle: V-Net Based Liver and Tumor Segmentation Using 3D ConditionalRandom Fields and Graph Cuts Method
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Automatic liver segmentation from 3D biomedical images is an essential task for many clinical applications and also helpful to radiologists and doctors to analyze and segment the liver tumor faster and accurately. However, it is still a challenging task due to the complex background of the liver, fuzzy boundary, and different appearance of liver and tumor. The present study was performed to propose more efficient deep learning based approach for liver and tumor segmentation from 3D CT scans using V-Net and two different post-processing methods: Conditional Random Field (CRF) and Graph Cuts. In propose approach, using 3-slice input and ResNet as base network outer performs by applying CRF as a post-processing step. Results are evaluated using different metrics that are used for biomedical images processing and with different combinations of parameters such as 3-slice input using ResNet with CRF and Graph Cuts. Results were significant by the proposed approach as compared to other state-of-the- art approaches. Tumor segmentation part are better than other approaches having 96.60%, 5.10%, -1.5%, 0.96mm, and 12.76mm for DSC, VOE, RVD, ASD, and MSD respectively for liver segmentation and 83.91%, 38.92%, -2.6%, 1.13mm and 5.76mm for DSC, VOE, RVD, ASD and MSD respectively for tumor segmentation.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a bluetooth data communication middleware on smart phone
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Due to the continuous improvement of data processing power of smartphones, Bluetooth Low Energy(BLE) in smartphone is more and more widely used as a data transceiver device in wireless environment. And the transmission speed of mobile Internet is increasing, making it possible for mobile phones to collect data, analyze and transfer data using BLE. Based on BLE's low power consumption and high speed, this paper designs and implements a communication middleware APP that uses BLE to do data collection, storage, analysis, encryption, forwarding and other functions on Android system. It has been tested in practical applications, and the speed of data acquisition and transfer can reach more than 500kb/s.

articleTitle: Construction of Guidance and Control System Framework for a Communication Equipment Simulation Training Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: According to the military requirement and application requirement of a communication equipment simulation training platform, the function requirement of a communication equipment simulation training platform guidance and control system(CESTPGC) is analyzed, the framework system of CESTPGC is constructed, and the key technology of the framework is analyzed. The framework design of the system has been successfully applied to the construction of CESTPGC. The results proves that the function, performance and control effect of the system fully meet the requirements of modularization and informationization.

articleTitle: Bibliometric Visualization Analysis of Sustainable Design from 2001 to 2021
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Based on the data of 1,430 sustainable design literature included in the Web of Science database from 2001 to 2021, this paper integrates the analytical advantages of CiteSpace and VOSviewer, and conducts field-specific bibliometric analysis and visualization presentation of results. The article analyzes the distribution and sources of the literature at the micro level, combs the research hotspots, branches and development frontiers at the macro level, providing a comprehensive and clear context combing of the sustainable design field.

articleTitle: Semantic Similarity Entity Disambiguation for Short Text
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the use of recommendation system and retrieval system, Named Entity Disambiguation (NED) is helpful to distinguish polysemy and synonym, so as to realize accurate retrieval and recommendation. Although existing statistics-based research methods achieve high accuracy, these studies have low accuracy when faced with short texts without context. To solve this problem, this essay proposes a Named Entity Disambiguation method based on Knowledge Graph similarity. The method is a semantic similarity model based on entity property similarity. The semantic similarity model based on entity property relies on embedding model and Knowledge Graph to learn the vector representation of words and features in the same shared vector space. Experimental results show that the Named Entity Disambiguation method proposed in this essay is more effective than the existing text-only statistical method when context information is scarce. In the expansibility experiment, this essay will discuss the influence of model parameter values on the precision of disambiguation results.

articleTitle: Research on Vibration Characteristics of Parametric Shell Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Considering the anisotropy of violin's material, this paper studies the stress-strain state and vibration response characteristics of the wooden shell (with air coupling) under external load through finite element analysis and nonlinear system simulation. On the other hand, the influence of size and structure, material, external load, air and other factors on the sound pressure vibration frequency of wooden shell after vibration is discussed. It provides some effective research approaches to solve the problems of fluid-structure interaction in the above engineering fields.

articleTitle: Ranked Hunger Games Search Algorithms with Gaussian Distribution-based Fitness Distance Balance Strategy
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Fitness-Distance Balance with Functional Weights (FW) is a new and improved selection method based on Fitness-Distance Balance (FDB). FDB can be used to solve the problem of premature convergence. And FW further improves the performance of FDB selection strategy by changing the weights in FDB from fixed values to randomly generated using distribution functions. Hunger Games Search (HGS) is a meta-heuristic algorithm created inspired by animal hunger behavior. HGS algorithm can get good performance when tested on various problems. But the HGS algorithm still has the problem of premature convergence and easily falls into local search. Therefore, we incorporate the FW selection strategy into the HGS algorithm and propose the FWHGS. and tested on the IEEE CEC2017 benchmark function, which has a great improvement compared to the HGS algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on entrepreneurial competency model under the background of digital economy
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Using the method of systematic literature review, this paper reviews the main literature from 1985 to 2020, analyzes different entrepreneurial competency models, reviews the evolution of entrepreneurial activities in the development of digital economy, and focuses on the impacts on entrepreneurial competency. At the same time, it investigates the competency elements under the background of digital economy, through the intersection between digital skills and entrepreneurial skills, integrates new digital elements with previous entrepreneurial competencies, and develops a new entrepreneurial competency model. The model is oriented to the digital background, integrates the basic entrepreneurial competencies and new digital competency elements required for entrepreneurship, identifies the basic entrepreneurial competencies and key digital competencies that entrepreneurs need to have for effective entrepreneurship. The new model deepens the understanding of entrepreneurial competencies under the digital economy background.

articleTitle: A BERT and Topic Model Based Approach to reviews Requirements Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: With the rise of mobile applications, user reviews are an important avenue of user feedback in which users may mention different issues in using the software. For example, unresponsiveness, low-level privacy, etc. In order to extract effective requirement information and problematic feedback from these huge user reviews, this paper proposes a review non-functional requirement analysis method based on BERT model and topic model (NRABL). Firstly, we use BERT model to classify the reviews with multi-labels classification and then use LDA (latent Dirichlet allocation) to extract topic and review analysis, this method can help developers to quickly understand the user's requirements and the specific usage problems.

articleTitle: An Explainable XGBoost-based Approach for Assessing Product Presentation Video
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Product presentation video, an essential medium for online product presentation, mainly conveys product information to consumers. The quality of product information expression will affect consumer's purchase experience, even purchase decisions. But many video production novices often have difficulty assessing the effectiveness of their videos and doing optimization. Thus, we adopt information mediums' perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use as assessment indicators, and propose an automatic explainable assessment method. The method is based on the combined use of the extreme gradient boosting algorithm and SHapley Additive exPlanations method, which is implemented to assess video samples and generate explanations on the assessment results. We create a product presentation video dataset for development and evaluation. The results show that our method can assess video effectively, and provide insights into the shortcomings of videos' production like experts.

articleTitle: A reduction model on multiplex terrorist network
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: Terrorist organizations usually have complex relationship types among terrorists, and multiplex network is effective on accurately model and analyze them. Howerver, the increase of the network layer causes the model complexity grow exponentially. Thus, a reduction method of multiplex network is supposed based on the association rule model and information difference index. The results show that the method can effectively reduce the complexity of the network without changing the main structure and function of the network.

articleTitle: Development Study on CBTC Related Techniques Based on Systematically Analyzing Granted Invention Patents of Past 20 Years
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: In the past 20 years or more, a new type of train operation and control system (OCS) - communication based train control (CBTC) has been widely concerned and studied by rail transit signal industry. CBTC is characterized by two-way communication between the train and ground through wireless communication, which is used to replace the track circuit to realize train operation control. Discussing the development of CBTC related technologies in the past 20 years is of certain significance to understand the development of urban rail transit. Till now, scholars have studied a variety of technologies involved in CBTC and multiple stages of system development, but the relevant research is mostly limited to the function and performance of CBTC in one aspect. As the invention patents applied in this field can be regarded as the best material for analyzing the development of CBTC related technologies, in this paper, through the search and analysis of CBTC related patents in the past 20 years, the development direction of CBTC related technologies has been clarified, and the development trend of CBTC and its related technologies has also been pointed out.

articleTitle: Taming the complexity of digital strategic action in e-commerce platforms: a configurational view
publicationTitle: 2021 14th International Symposium on Computational Intelligence and Design (ISCID)
abstract: This study examines how e-commerce platforms use complex resources to orchestrate competitive digital strategic actions in hypercompetitive context. Based on the complex theory and competitive dynamic, we suggest a configurational analytic framework. In a holistic and non-linear way, we examine how the configurations of digital strategic action formed by e-commerce platform resources creates value through effects that are difficult for competitors to respond to. In line with this approach, we use fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis to news data from Chinese online tourism industry. Our findings suggest equifinal pathways to gain the effect that is hard to be responded.
